svg.title: OTIS Compose architecture: foundation to application
svg.desc: Bottom-up layers: Docker Engine, two Docker Compose projects, OTIS workloads. The browser uses Nginx, Rust and OpenSearch. A separate demo mailbox feeds read-only IMAP to Rust. OpenSearch stores search, custody and private state and runs local CPU inference.
svg.text: Separate demo mail project and persistent volumes
Link labels use service ports; mailbox host ports appear on the mailbox.
Compose is the local demo profile. Optional native OIDC uses its separate overlay.
Application and mailbox projects share a local container runtime.
